review_type: AI editorial review of A2 speaking tasks in the four official DUO types (video-answer, picture-describe, picture-choose, picture-sequence) and their sentence starters: official instruction wording, cues and voice roles, image briefs against the house style and cast, criteria that mirror the type, sample quotes with learner errors, model coverage and level, originality against the catalogue and batch 027; repairs applied in the proposed file
summary: All twelve tasks pass in the proposed file. Three recommended edits: bibliotheekboek relabelled winkels-diensten, fiets-lopen relabelled vervoer, the papers in bibliotheekboek panel 1 declared blank. No wording, criterion, sample, model or starter changed; no task rejected. Learner errors in the samples kept as the author brief asks; the no-fine library ending kept. Every task comparable to the official task of its type; no level flag. Checker on the proposed file: no failures, no warnings.

edits.why: A public library is a service counter, not an instantie in the inburgering sense (gemeente, UWV, DUO, belastingdienst, politie; blueprint §9 lists gemeente letters, toeslagen, DigiD and a police report as the instanties needs). The catalogue’s opleiding label for library items covered a course and opening hours, not a loan. Instanties is already the largest A2 domain in the catalogue (31), winkels-diensten has 15. Decision on doubt 6.

Same choose template as 009 trein-auto and 027 bus-fiets, both labelled vervoer; the content is the mode of transport, the workplace only the destination; vervoer is the least represented A2 domain (11). Decision on doubt 10.

decisions_on_author_doubts.1_video_answer_prompt_sentence: Keep ‘U hoort de vraag.’: matches the six integrated 009 tasks and 027; blueprint §4.3 should record the composite pattern (coordinator).
decisions_on_author_doubts.2_woorden_leren_vs_thuis_oefenen: Keep as written: different act (memory method plus a concrete word vs habits and frequency), speaker and register; alternative cue not needed; not in one video drill with thuis-oefenen or 027 taalcafe-oefenen.
decisions_on_author_doubts.3_regen_vs_bushalte: Keep the bus: different type and act; the platform variant would collide with treinkaartje panel 2; not both bus stops in one form.
decisions_on_author_doubts.4_schoolplein_vs_gymles: Keep the ball: another scene and act; a ball is a shared motif and the most nameable A2 action; scooter variant not applied; not in one describe drill with gymles.
decisions_on_author_doubts.5_treinkaartje_vs_tramkaart: Keep; the pre-blueprint items are another format; different sets.
decisions_on_author_doubts.7_no_fine_panel: Keep the new book: fines vary by library, a payment panel would be wrong for part of the country and adds a text-prone object; the lateness sits in the prompt and panel 1.
decisions_on_author_doubts.8_learner_errors_in_samples: Keep: the author brief asks for them; sample and quotes are feedback fixtures not shown in the app; quotes verbatim with the errors; errors typical. ‘op de bank’ is acceptable Dutch for a bench, harmless.
decisions_on_author_doubts.9_geslaagd_premise: Keep; role-play, no claim about the learner.
decisions_on_author_doubts.11_fatima_coat_in_kitchen: Keep (cast rule; 027 keuken does the same).
decisions_on_author_doubts.12_reason_for_visit: Keep; mild complaints, and the desk question is what the assistant asks.
decisions_on_author_doubts.13_pairs_with_different_rooms: Accepted as 009 gemeente-bellen: the place is the thing chosen; person, clothes, shirt and companions constant.
decisions_on_author_doubts.14_modibo_twice: Accepted (different onderdelen); keep his four tasks (woorden-leren, bibliotheekboek, 009 rijbewijs, 027 verhuizen) apart in sets.
decisions_on_author_doubts.15_neighbours_in_027: Recorded in set_assembly; two more found (lunchpauze/027 ziekmelden, marktkraam/027 kassa).
